title: AES-GCM encrypt: authTagSz=0 returns success with garbage tag
description: crypto2dev_cipher():L800-817 guards GET_TAG with `authTag \!= NULL && authTagSz > 0 && authTagSz <= CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN`. If any condition is false, the tag is silently not retrieved, the function returns 0, and the caller's tag buffer is unmodified (zeros or garbage). On decrypt the same conditions return BUFFER_E — correct and asymmetric. Any direct port caller with authTagSz=0 gets success with an unverifiable authentication tag. wolfSSL's own wc_AesGcmEncrypt validates authTag/authTagSz \!= 0 before calling CryptoCb, but the port's API is public.
